name: record_quote_outcome
description: Persist one terminal private-number rehearsal outcome as a synthetic manual_handoff. After consent, it may include a clearly spoken numeric premium; without consent it may store only a minimal human-request status with no premium. Every record remains excluded from official market ranking.

outcomeStatus.description: Use manual_handoff for both a consented synthetic spoken-price result and a declined-AI human request. Use unreachable only when the call ends without consent, price or a handoff request.

premiumAmount.description: The numeric amount actually spoken in the role-play, for example 200 or 220. Normalize pounds, dollars or bucks to a numeric CAD demo amount. Include only after consent; omit for a human request or unreachable outcome.

premiumPeriod.description: The period actually stated for the premium. Omit when no premium was provided.

coverageSummary.description: For a spoken-price result, use the supplied synthetic profile and coverage summaries. For handoff or unreachable, use 'No quote details collected.'

quoteReference.description: A non-sensitive quote reference actually provided. Omit when none was provided.

blocker.description: For manual_handoff use 'AI assistance declined; participant requested a real person.' Omit when a spoken demo premium was captured.

evidenceNote.constant_value: Supervised private-number simulation; excluded from market metrics.

consentConfirmed.description: Set true only after the person affirmatively agreed to continue and save a structured non-audio demo summary. It may be false for a minimal human-handoff status with no premium or quote details.
